family: liquidity-provision reversal conditioned on market stress
idea: Short-horizon losers rebound; premium for absorbing price pressure, larger in stress
market: US liquid stocks top-1000 Alpaca SIP
signal: short-term reversal liquidity provision volatility stress cross-sectional
diagnosis: No gross advantage over the equal-weight eligible control in any config (B0 -6.6 bp/day [-19.7,+6.2]; best C1 5-day reversal +5.5 [-10.1,+21.4]); stress-state conditioning (C3) adds nothing (-1.8). Costs are large because open-to-open trading pays the measured 09:31 spread (median 5-26 bp half-spread by liquidity band) on ~100% daily turnover, but the rejection does not depend on them: gross alone fails. Selection recomputed independently on 4 days, 0 mismatches. Lesson: in 2020-22 large/mid caps, 1-day and 5-day open-to-open reversal is not a usable gross signal; opening execution is the most expensive minute of the day.
